paragraphs.text: It was a different conversation. At the alumni supper, the tablecloths were folded into squares after the guests left, and the steward counted the borrowed silver before returning it to its case.

This is a different problem because the scanner reads the barcode correctly but the checkout database maps it to the wrong item. Cleaning the lens cannot change that mapping; correcting the product record can.
